description: This file declares the SharedStorage class, which implements interfaces for plugin management, JSON-RPC communication, and store notifications within the WPEFramework plugin system. It defines methods for handling persistent storage operations such as get, set, delete, and namespace management, along with notification mechanisms for value changes.

classes.name: SharedStorage
classes.description: Implements storage-related JSON-RPC endpoints and notification handling within the plugin framework.

classes.name: Store2Notification
classes.description: A nested class handling notifications from IStore2, relaying value changes to the parent SharedStorage class.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided shell/service.

methods.name: endpoint_setValue
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the persistent storage.

methods.name: endpoint_getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value for a given key from storage.

methods.name: endpoint_deleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a specific key from storage.

methods.name: endpoint_deleteNamespace
methods.description: Deletes an entire namespace from storage.

methods.name: endpoint_getKeys
methods.description: Retrieves all keys within a namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_getNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Retrieves storage limit for a namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_setNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Sets storage limit for a namespace.

methods.name: getRemoteStoreObject
methods.description: Obtains a remote store object based on scope.
